attributes.action: Reatin Transitional Arrangement for Refugees claimed Asylum before March 2 2026
attributes.additional_details: Placing previously recognised refugees into the new Core Protection system by scraping the transitional arrangement is unfair and breaches their legitimate expectations. For individuals who have already waited nearly 20 years for refugee status due to complex cases, adding another two decades of insecurity before settlement is untenable. The Home Office must reinstate the transitional arrangement to ensure procedural fairness.
attributes.background: In the November 2 consultation response document the government indicated that the transitional arrangement for pre-2 March 2026 refugees from the ILR reform will be removed in page 34. Reinstate this transitional arrangement for previously recognized refugees who are already in the country.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Protect existing refugees from retrospective settlement rule changes" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786148
